purpose: Teach: 苦しめ/多量/容姿/昼過ぎ/晴天/言わば/手渡し/向っ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんを苦しめないように静かに遊びましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's play quietly so we don't wear Dad out, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact instruction. Warm and protective without fussing. Light touch on the reminder—she's said this before. Composed, mother's voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと多量の落ち葉を集めたよ
lines.en: Mom, I collected a lot of fallen leaves with Dad today!
lines.style: Bright, excited bursting out. Quick pace, eager to share. The pride of accomplishment mixed with joy at the memory. Genuine six-year-old enthusiasm—no performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、人を容姿で判断しちゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, we don't judge people by how they look, remember?
lines.style: Steady, instructive tone. Not scolding—teaching. Clear and direct, the way she'd explain something important. Eyes-level, no condescension.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、昼過ぎにお父さんとお散歩したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went for a walk this afternoon!
lines.style: Eager to report, seeking her attention and approval. Bright, simple delivery. The naturalness of a child sharing his day—no filter, just joy in the telling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、今日は晴天だから洗濯日和ね
lines.en: Sho, it's such nice weather today—perfect for laundry.
lines.style: Observational, slightly to herself. Warm practicality. The tone of a mother noticing both the day and her son. Quiet contentment underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが言わば家族のリーダーだって思うよ
lines.en: Mom, I think Dad is kind of the leader of our family, you know?
lines.style: Thoughtful, tentative. Hesitant—not quite sure if he's allowed to think this or say it. Soft, sincere. The voice of a child working something out for the first time.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに手渡しでお手紙を渡しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's give this letter to Dad by hand, okay?
lines.style: Tender, purposeful. A gentle instruction wrapped in care. Creates a small moment. Warm but not saccharine—the mother's voice creating something she wants him to remember.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの方に向って走ったよ
lines.style: Breathless with immediate joy. Quick, eager delivery. The excitement of action just finished—he's still riding the happiness of the moment. Childlike immediacy, no reflection yet.
